messages.question: Ultracode needs claude CLI ≥2.1.154 (you're on 2.1.120) — upgrade the CLI now, or wire the flag so it activates on your next upgrade?
messages.context: Verified: --effort only accepts low|medium|high|xhigh|max. "Ultra" is NOT a CLI level — ultrathink is a prompt keyword that does not change API effort. "Ultracode" IS real but is a settings boolean {"ultracode":true} = xhigh + dynamic workflow orchestration, shipped in 2.1.154+. On 2.1.120 the key is silently ignored, so you'd get plain xhigh with no orchestration. Auto-effort routing (part 2 of your ask) is unaffected either way and I'll build it regardless.
